model_system: 12-site (2x2 enlarged-cell) kagome lattice model for AV3Sb5 (A = Cs, Rb, K) with coexisting loop-current (LC) and Star-of-David bond-order (BO) order

key_params.pairing_interaction_g: on-site attractive g > 0; chiral d-wave realized for g < 0.5

headline_claim: Under pure loop-current order eta = 0.014, the chiral d-wave pairing eigenvalue rises sharply below about 5 meV and becomes the superconducting instability, yielding a chiral d-wave state with Tc << 4 meV for g < 0.5.
replication_difficulty: medium - straightforward custom gap-equation diagonalization on a 12-site kagome supercell, but requires reconstructing the LC/BO form factors and Green's function precisely.
